title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description: At Pflegia we are building and operating an innovative job matching platform, which intelligently brings together caregivers and healthcare employers. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis! Therefore we are looking for reinforcement to build up our internal web development department. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market together with us! Tasks What You’ll Do Take full ownership of projects from conception to deployment, in iteration cycles. Deliver high quality code with a high productivity rate Foster a collaborative, supportive and highly performing team environment. Conduct regular code reviews and offer constructive feedback to team members, raising them to the next level. Responsibilities Exhibit strong proficiency in full stack development. Architect scalable and maintainable software and infrastructure solutions. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices. Effectively communicate project requirements, progress, and challenges to stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and coordination. Proactively identify and address technical challenges. Implement innovative solutions to optimize performance and efficiency. Develop project timelines and milestones, ensuring timely delivery. Prioritize tasks and allocate resources effectively. Requirements Several high business impact projects you have led or championed Great Typescript and SQL skills Good to have: React, react-admin, Next.js, Nest.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL Great to have: Knowledge in data engineering (ETL) and in data analytics Test methodologies and their tools (Jest or similar) Very good knowledge of security and its best practices Cloud-Experience with Azure, AWS, Vercel Agile and SCRUM process management methodology Excellent verbal and written communication and conceptualization skills in English (German is a plus) Good time management and organizational skills Benefits Real ownership. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths: you will not need a committee to ship. AI coding tools provided and expected, with room to shape how the team uses them. Direct access to the data: our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics, so you can check the effect of your own work. Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front. Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership. An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere. Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote. title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
description: Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it. You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients. What you will be doing: Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs) What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology A genuine interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? Highly competitive salary Flexible working with full time or part time options Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us Private healthcare scheme No night shifts and no on call CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK Training and development: Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu Specialist training delivered by experts Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems Working arrangements: Fully remote with flexible working hours and days Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care About Montu Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago. If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you. Compensation: £190K – £275K • Based on hours worked per week & experience £190K – £275K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description: Redpanda is the first runtime and control plane for agent-data interaction — a unified platform that combines streaming, SQL analytics, and intelligent connectivity with the governance layer enterprise AI agents need in production. Built on infrastructure already trusted by Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing startups, Redpanda enforces governance entirely outside the agent's data path, controlling what agents see, limiting what they do, and capturing a tamper-proof record of everything they touch, so organizations never have to choose between innovation and control. About the Role: Technical Customer Success Managers own the post-sale technical relationship with our customers. You will drive accelerated time to production, keep deployments healthy as they scale, and turn technical success into customer-led growth and industry-leading NRR (Net Revenue Retention). You are the customer's trusted technical advisor: you understand their architecture, anticipate issues before they escalate, and coordinate the right Redpanda resources to resolve them. You Will: Lead technical onboarding and adoption, from architecture review through production go-live, against a customer-agreed success plan and timeline Run regular cluster health checks and usage reviews using telemetry and dashboards to spot risk, capacity issues, and expansion opportunities early Own technical escalations end to end, partnering with Support and Engineering to drive root cause analysis and resolution Translate customer requirements into clear, prioritized feedback for Product Management and Engineering Act as the customer's trusted advisor and advocate, aligning Solutions Architects, Engineering, Product, and Support as needed Communicate confidently with engineering teams, platform owners, and senior leadership You Have: 4+ years in a TAM, technical CSM, or post-sales engineering role supporting data infrastructure, distributed systems, or developer platforms Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts such as replication, partitioning, throughput, and latency Hands-on familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) and with Kubernetes Understanding of networking concepts (VPC peering, PrivateLink, DNS, TLS) Proven ability to manage technical escalations to mutually agreeable outcomes Strong program and stakeholder management across technical and executive audiences Ability to break down complex problems into manageable components and drive solutions Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts concisely to non-technical stakeholders Experience working in a fast-moving, 100% distributed team Nice to Have: Hands-on Apache Kafka or streaming experience (Kafka, Confluent, Pulsar, Kinesis) Experience with large-scale data platforms or complex enterprise software implementations Observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) Scripting in Python or Bash Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (AWS, CKA) SFDC, Metabase, Qlik Familiarity with MEDDIC or similar sales methodologies Join Redpanda if you’d enjoy being part of a fast-moving, diverse, people-first organization with team members around the globe and a culture based on trust, transparency, communication, and kindness. You'll dive into a nimble, high-impact team with the latest AI tools — and the budget to actually use them. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Director
description: About Valiantys Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com . Job summary Valiantys is looking for a Strategic Account Director to accelerate growth across our most important enterprise clients and prospects. This role is a senior, services-led growth position for a commercially ambitious leader who can create opportunity at executive level, shape complex transformation agendas and convert them into significant consulting, professional services and long-term managed services relationships. You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen. Your mandate is clear: open doors, create demand, expand strategic relationships and build substantial, sustainable services revenue. Your impact Strategic Accounts For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time. You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization. What you will do Strategic account leadership You will think like the CEO of your accounts. That means understanding each client’s strategy, organization, technology landscape, investment priorities, stakeholders and competitive dynamics and translating that intelligence into a deliberate growth strategy. You will build and execute account plans that answer three fundamental questions: Where can Valiantys create the greatest value? Who do we need to influence to make that happen? How do we turn that value into sustainable commercial growth? You will develop relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, create executive sponsorship, uncover new buying centers and build a strong pipeline of opportunities capable of materially growing each account. Selling outcomes, not capacity The strongest candidates will understand that sophisticated services sales is not about selling consultants, days or technical resources. It is about selling change and business outcomes. You will lead discovery around the client’s most important challenges and ambitions, working with Valiantys’ consulting and technical experts to turn those conversations into propositions that have clear strategic relevance and measurable value. Whether the opportunity involves enterprise transformation, ITSM/ESM, cloud, DevOps, platform strategy, AI, operating-model change or managed services, you will ensure the conversation begins with the client’s desired outcome, not the technology. Orchestrating Valiantys Complex services opportunities are won as a team. You will act as the commercial orchestrator for your accounts, bringing together the best of Valiantys across consulting, solution architecture, delivery, customer success, managed services and executive leadership. You will create clarity around the client’s ambition, establish a compelling win strategy and ensure our teams are aligned around the outcome we are trying to achieve. You will also work closely with Atlassian and our broader partner ecosystem, building strong field relationships and turning platform opportunities into larger transformation and services engagements. Your objective is not simply to participate in opportunities. It is to shape them. Bring commercial discipline Maintain accurate forecasting, qualification and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle. Apply MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to create clarity, momentum and accountability. Contribute to strategic account planning, regional strategy and commercial reporting. Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement. Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization. What you need to be successful We are looking for a sophisticated enterprise seller with a strong record of building and closing significant consulting and professional services business with more than 10 years of experience minimum. You will bring most of the following: A proven track record of winning complex, high-value professional services, consulting or transformation engagements within enterprise organizations. Evidence of consistently delivering against ambitious services revenue and bookings targets. Strong experience growing strategic accounts and creating substantial new revenue within existing client relationships. The ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, combining commercial confidence with intellectual curiosity. The ability to move comfortably between strategic business conversations and the commercial detail required to get complex deals signed. Experience creating opportunities where no formal requirement or RFP previously existed. Strong commercial judgment across pricing, scope, margin, contracting, negotiation and deal structure. The ability to navigate complex organizations, political environments and multi-stakeholder buying processes. Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams around large pursuits. Strong forecasting, pipeline management and opportunity qualification discipline. Experience within technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise service management, ITSM, cloud, DevOps, AI transformation or the Atlassian ecosystem would be highly valuable. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity. If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you. Why Valiantys? Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. You will work with experienced specialists who care about the quality of the outcome—not just the signature of the contract. What we offer An international, multicultural team and a genuinely European scope. A flexible telework program. Personal dental plan and health insurance fully funded by Valiantys. Choice of PC or Mac. Training time and budget to support your development. Ready to create momentum? If you are looking for a role where you can combine enterprise selling, strategic thinking and real customer impact, we would like to hear from you. title: Account Manager, Customer Success
description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. As an Account Manager, Customer Success, you'll own the commercial and strategic health of a portfolio of Pencil accounts — the roadmap of what's next, the relationship with key stakeholders, and the confidence that someone at Pencil is thinking ahead on their behalf. You'll work in lockstep with your Customer Success Technical Manager counterpart, who owns the day-to-day platform experience, while you own the account's trajectory: expansion, renewal, and the story we tell the client about where the partnership is heading. You're the client's proof that someone is thinking ahead about their account and has their back when it counts. Candidates must be located on the East Coast and within the Eastern Time Zone. Key responsibilities: Own the day-to-day commercial and strategic health of a portfolio of accounts, building trusted relationships with the stakeholders who hold the budget and the renewal decision. Build and run the account's cadence — QBRs, roadmap conversations, and renewal timelines — supporting in helping bring a clear narrative on where the partnership is heading and why. Partner closely with your CST counterpart so nothing falls in the gap between the platform and the account — support patterns feed your account plan, and your account strategy shapes what CST prioritizes. Keep account documentation, trackers, and materials complete, current, and client-ready before anything goes out the door — you are the source of truth for your accounts. Proactively identify and pursue expansion and upsell opportunities by understanding client goals, usage patterns, and where Pencil can create more value. Your background: 3-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing commercial roles, ideally in SaaS, advertising, or marketing tech. Agency experience is essential. Candidates must have experience managing 3–7 client accounts simultaneously, with strong organisational and account management skills. Track record of owning renewals and growing accounts, with strong client-facing communication and presentation skills. Comfortable operating one layer up from the tool — thinking in terms of account strategy, commercial structure, and stakeholder relationships rather than platform mechanics. Experience building and maintaining clear, organized account documentation (trackers, QBR decks, account plans) that clients and internal teams can rely on. Familiarity with subscription-based business models and a genuine curiosity about how generative AI is changing marketing and creative workflows. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You're commercially minded but always focused on client success — you can hold both at once. You take ownership of your accounts end-to-end: you don't wait to be asked, you bring net-new thinking to move things forward. You communicate proactively and clearly, giving stakeholders visibility before they have to chase you for it. You care about polish — the decks, trackers, and materials you send a client are complete and considered before they land in an inbox. You enjoy partnership: you build real working relationships with your CST counterpart and with agency partners like OLIVER, rather than working around them. KPIs & Success Measures Account retention and renewal rate across your portfolio. Expansion and upsell revenue generated from existing accounts. QBR and account plan quality and cadence — consistently delivered, on time, and grounded in a clear narrative. Client satisfaction / NPS across your accounts. Documentation and tracker currency — account materials are always complete and up to date. Proactive communication — stakeholders have visibility into account status without needing to chase it. Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Flexible working hours Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Empower every employee. Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen. Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenausschreibung KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen. Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen. Was dich erwartet KI-Architektur verantworten : Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab. Die größte Herausforderung annehmen : Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Die Disziplin führen und weiterentwickeln : Übernimm die disziplinarische Führung für drei KI-Engineers und hilf ihnen dabei, sich zu Engineers zu entwickeln, die den technischen Maßstab selbst setzen. Hands-on bleiben : Rund 70 Prozent deiner Zeit verbringst du im Code, an den Problemen, bei denen dein Urteilsvermögen am meisten zählt. Der Rest entfällt auf technische und disziplinarische Führung. Produktübergreifend Einfluss nehmen : Setze Architekturentscheidungen mit den Product Managern und Engineering Leads um, die die Roadmaps verantworten, die nicht in deinem Bereich liegen, und überzeuge dabei durch das bessere Argument statt durch Weisung. Mit unserem Stack arbeiten : Python, pydantic-ai für Orchestrierung, Qdrant für Vektorsuche, Azure AI für Modelle, deployed auf Kubernetes in ein überwiegend JVM-basiertes (Kotlin, Micronaut) und Go-Backend. Eine junge Disziplin mitgestalten : KI-Engineering ist bei Flip so neu, dass es enormen Gestaltungsspielraum gibt und noch kein festes Playbook existiert. Was du mitbringst Wir suchen einen Engineer mit einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament und echter Praxiserfahrung mit agentenbasierten Systemen in Produktion, der eine Disziplin führen möchte, statt nur an einer Codebase zu arbeiten. Wenn dich die Rolle reizt, du aber nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Must-haves: 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz auf Senior- oder Staff-Level, aufbauend auf einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament (Backend, Platform oder Full-Stack). Praxiserfahrung im Design, Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver LLM-basierter Systeme: RAG, Tool Calling und MCP, Orchestrierung und Evals. Keine Prototypen, sondern Systeme, mit denen du auch nach dem Go-live gelebt hast. Erfahrung mit Multi-Agenten-Orchestrierung, die besonders stark gewichtet wird. Das ist der Kern dessen, was du architektonisch verantworten würdest. Nachgewiesene technische Führungserfahrung: Architekturverantwortung, Tech-Lead-Verantwortung, RFCs, Design Reviews oder das Setzen von Standards für ein Team. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit voranzubringen, die nicht in deinem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich liegt: Du gewinnst Architekturdiskussionen durch Überzeugungskraft und Glaubwürdigkeit und bist es gewohnt, recht zu haben, ohne die Entscheidungsgewalt zu haben. Nachweise dafür, dass du Menschen weiterentwickelst: Coaching oder Mentoring von Engineers hin zu stärkeren Engineers, statt ihnen die Arbeit abzunehmen. Ein klares, ausdrückliches Bekenntnis zu disziplinarischer Führung. Diese Rolle umfasst die Führung von drei Engineers, und das ist nicht der Teil, den du nur in Kauf nimmst, um den technischen Scope zu bekommen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (C1). title: Lead AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Empower every employee. Flip is the leading AI-powered employee experience platform for frontline workers. We're transforming how people do their jobs across the industries that keep the world running: retail, manufacturing, and logistics. One app. One touch. Everything they need. Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job Description AI orchestration is at the centre of where Flip is going. Fusion, a multi-agent code-generation system sits at the core of our newest product, and our Ask AI agent gateway and Flip Flows automation both run on capabilities our AI engineers build and maintain. As Lead AI Engineer you take over the AI discipline: you own the how (architecture, standards, technical direction) across all three surfaces, you lead and grow a team of three AI engineers, and you stay hands-on where the problems are hardest. What you can expect Own the AI architecture: Define and align a coherent AI architecture and set of standards across Flip Fusion, Ask AI agent gateway, and Flip Flows. Tackle the hardest challenge: Multi-agent systems, built to specific purposes, generalizable enough for diverse customers, balancing high expectations with feasibility, reliability and cost effectiveness. Lead and grow the discipline: Take over people leadership for three AI engineers and help them level up into engineers who set the technical bar themselves. Stay hands-on: Roughly 70 percent of your time stays in the code, on the problems where your judgment matters most. The rest is technical and people leadership. Influence across products: Land architecture decisions with the product managers and engineering leads who own the roadmaps you don't, by making the better argument rather than by mandate. Work with our stack: Python, pydantic-ai for orchestration, qdrant for vector search, Azure AI for models, deployed on Kubernetes into a mostly JVM-based (Kotlin, Micronaut) and Go backend. Shape a young discipline: AI engineering at Flip is new enough that there is enormous design space and no inherited playbook. What you bring to the table We're looking for an engineer with a software engineering foundation and real production depth in agentic systems, who wants to lead a discipline rather than just work a codebase. If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you. Must-haves: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a senior or staff-level track record, built on a software engineering foundation (backend, platform, or full-stack) Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered systems in production: RAG, tool calling and MCP, orchestration, and evals. Not prototypes, systems you lived with after go-live. Experience with multi-agent orchestration, weighted heavily. This is the core of what you would be architecting. Demonstrated technical leadership: architecture ownership, tech lead responsibility, RFCs, design reviews, or setting standards for a team. Proven ability to move technical work you don't own: you win architecture arguments through persuasion and credibility, and you're comfortable being right without being in charge. Evidence that you grow people: coaching or mentoring engineers into stronger engineers rather than absorbing the work yourself. A clear, explicit commitment to people leadership. This role includes managing three engineers and that is not the part you tolerate to get the technical scope. Strong communication skills and business-fluent English (C1). Nice-to-haves: Formal people-management experience: line management, performance and development conversations, hiring. Strong mentoring evidence counts just as much. Experience leading a discipline or craft across teams in a matrix organisation. Product context at scale: frontline or deskless workforces, high-volume B2B SaaS, or comparable. Cost, latency and reliability engineering for LLM systems: guardrails, fallbacks, evaluation harnesses. German at any level. Useful in parts of the company, never required for this role. What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview. Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing. Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere. Be part of something bigger : You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed. Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters. Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview. At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity , origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in! title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
description: Senior Design Quality Engineer In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll safeguard product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from design controls while we build, to complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together. Who We Are Bayesian Health 's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes. About the Role Bayesian ships FDA-cleared, AI clinical decision support software directly into Epic and Oracle Health workflows at health systems across the country. Every release, every model update, and every clinician report that an alert didn't behave as expected runs through a quality and regulatory system that has to be as rigorous as the software itself. You will help drive that system. This role intentionally wears multiple hats. We're a small company, and we need one person who can do several things well: engineer quality into the software as it's built, handle the post-market side once it's in production, and keep the quality management system and our regulatory obligations current as we scale. You'll work directly with engineering, data science, clinical, and implementation teams, with support from company leadership, while under the direction of the Head of Quality and Regulatory. You're the engineer in the room on quality questions. When a hospital reports that the model flagged a patient late, you decide whether it's a complaint, whether it's reportable, and what changed in the software or the data. You can read the code, the logs, and the test evidence to find out. What You'll Own Software Design Quality Partner with engineering and data science through the full software lifecycle: requirements, architecture review, software risk analysis, verification and validation, traceability, and release readiness in accordance with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR 820 (QMSR) design controls. Keep the design history file and risk management file current, right-sized, and defensible. Change Control & Algorithm Lifecycle Assess software and model changes for regulatory impact, determining whether a letter-to-file or a new submission applies, and drive the change through the quality management system. Maintain the risk file and support post-market performance monitoring of the deployed algorithm. Complaint Handling & Post-Market Surveillance Support complaint intake, triage, investigation, and closure. Prepare MDR reportability assessments under 21 CFR 803 for review and approval, trend complaints and field data, and lead nonconformance reports and CAPAs when patterns emerge. Work closely with the implementation and clinical teams, who hear from clients first, to make sure feedback reaches the quality system. QMS Improvement & Maintenance Maintain and update quality procedures, document control, training records, and compliance evidence as the company grows. Support internal audits, prepare management review inputs, and manage supplier controls for EHR, cloud, and subcontractor relationships. Regulatory Interactions & Submissions Contribute to 510(k)s, Q-Submissions, and Predetermined Change Control Plans. Respond to FDA questions and support the team during FDA inspections. Regulatory Intelligence Monitor FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled devices, cybersecurity under Section 524B, and quality system expectations. Translate emerging requirements into concrete changes to procedures and product requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration Embed compliance into how product, engineering, and commercial teams already work, so that quality speeds delivery rather than slowing it down. Communicate quality metrics and risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives. What You'll Bring A BS in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 5+ years in software quality, design quality engineering, or regulatory work for software medical devices under ISO 13485 and IEC 62304, including hands-on ownership of design controls and ISO 14971 risk management files Experience with complaint handling and adverse event reportability decisions under 21 CFR 803 and 21 CFR 820 (QSR or QMSR), including complaint investigation, trending, and CAPA A track record of writing, maintaining, and improving QMS procedures, document control, and change management in a regulated software environment The ability to read code, logs, and automated test results well enough to investigate a software issue independently, and comfort working with engineers in a cloud-based SaaS environment Working knowledge of FDA premarket cybersecurity expectations under Section 524B, including threat modeling, SBOM management, and vulnerability handling Excellent written communication. You produce audit-ready records and can explain regulatory concepts to engineers, clinicians, and executives without losing precision A high level of drive, a process-fixer mindset rather than a process-follower one, and the ability to learn fast and communicate clearly Current, unrestricted authorization to work in the United States Nice to Haves Experience with AI/ML-enabled medical devices, including algorithm change control, Predetermined Change Control Plans, model performance monitoring, and FDA AI/ML guidance Direct experience preparing 510(k)s or Q-Submissions and corresponding with FDA reviewers Familiarity with EHR-integrated software such as Epic or Oracle Health, SMART on FHIR, or CDS Hooks, and the security and quality due diligence enterprise health systems perform on vendors Experience supporting a lead or primary contact in FDA inspections, ISO 13485 certification audits, or customer audits Experience with eQMS platforms, Jira-based defect tracking, and computerized system validation An ASQ CQE/CSQE, RAC, or equivalent quality or regulatory certification Life at Bayesian We're a small, mission-driven team building AI tools that help clinicians catch life-threatening conditions earlier. We work remotely but stay closely connected in real time. We believe that closer collaboration helps us move faster for the hospitals and patients who depend on us. Our values guide how we work every day: Patients at the center. We hold ourselves to a high bar for excellence and impact. Hard problems, real breakthroughs. We pursue new ideas even when it's uncomfortable. No surprises, clear signals. We communicate clearly and honestly, so teams and customers can trust us. Whole people, shared respect. We treat teammates with respect and make space to grow. Truth seekers, stronger together. We debate openly and align around shared goals. What We Offer Medical, Dental & Vision: Coverage through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, including an HSA-eligible option, plus dental and vision through Guardian/VSP. Bayesian covers the majority of your premium and a meaningful share of your dependents' coverage. Enrolled members also get access to One Medical for same-day and 24/7 virtual primary care. Life & Disability: Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability, fully company-paid. 401(k): A company retirement plan with your choice of investment approach. Wellbeing: Free mental health support through Spring Health, plus additional wellness resources including pet care benefits and more. Time Off: Generous PTO that grows with tenure, paid sick time, paid holidays, and occasional company-wide self-care days. Equity: You'll also receive equity, so you share directly in what we build together. Team Retreats: A fully paid annual company retreat to connect with the team in person. Equipment: Your choice of Mac hardware, a one-time home office stipend, and ongoing reimbursement for internet and phone costs. Team: Quality & Regulatory Reports to: Head of Quality & Regulatory Level: Senior individual contributor Employment Classification: Full-Time with Benefits FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Remote - US Only Salary: $142,768 - $161,901 Candidates based in certain high-cost cities may be eligible for a geographic premium. Bayesian Health is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals, including for disability, pregnancy-related conditions, and religious practice. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, contact careers@bayesianhealth.com. Candidates must have current, unrestricted authorization to work in the United States. title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Become a Quality Engineer for Bloomreach! The Data Pipeline team is a backend-focused engineering team that cares deeply about quality and reliability. We believe in autonomy, we trust data, and we own what we ship end-to-end. We move our customers' data in and out of Bloomreach Engagement reliably and at a high rate: Our clients feed their visitors' behavior through real-time tracking to our platform. The data then can be analyzed and used for marketing automation. We process tens of thousands of requests per second . Imports are critical for our clients to utilize our platform to the fullest. We import millions of rows of data and continuously improve the throughput and reliability of our imports and integrations with other data storages. We are also responsible for exporting data from our platform to Google's BigQuery using Google's DataFlows, PySpark and Apache Beam, allowing data access by our clients. We run and support our services in production, handling high-volume traffic using Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes . Every one of these flows is something our customers rely on being correct, at scale. That is the terrain your testing and automation will cover. You won't be doing this alone: you'll join an experienced Senior Quality Engineer already on the team, so you'll have a buddy to ramp up with, bounce ideas off, and share the quality mission with from day one. We work remotely first (from Central & Eastern Europe), but we are more than happy to meet you in our nice offices in Bratislava, Brno or Prague. And if you are interested in who will be your engineering manager, check out Adam's LinkedIn . Intrigued? Read on ... What challenge awaits you? As a Quality Engineer in Data Pipeline, you own quality for systems that move huge volumes of customers' data in real time, at scale, across many integrations. This is a backend, data-heavy world: a tracking API on one side, an internal message format and multiple storages on the other, with Kafka, GCP and Kubernetes in between. Guaranteeing quality here means understanding how data flows end-to-end and where it can go wrong. We need you to bring engineering rigor to that quality. Concretely, you will: Own end-to-end and integration testing. Complex data pipelines can behave correctly component by component yet still surprise you end-to-end. You design the tests that validate real behavior across components, so we can ship changes to high-scale integrations with confidence. Build automation that runs repeatedly in CI. Turn testing into automated integration and end-to-end suites (e.g. Robot Framework, API tests) wired into the deployment pipeline, giving engineers fast, reliable feedback on every change. Go deep in the imports domain. Imports are a rich, well-defined area with plenty to reason about. You'll build deep context so you can proactively tell the team what to test, how, and why , and where the edge cases hide. Shift left. Be part of grooming and design from day one, thinking about test cases and failure modes while features are being shaped rather than after the fact. Strengthen the pipeline core too. Beyond imports, help raise quality across the Data Pipeline core as you grow context. Partner with the developers. Quality is a shared responsibility: developers own their in-source tests and you add the outside-in automation layer and perspective. You make the whole team better at testing, not the place work gets handed off to. Your responsibilities Design and own black-box, API-level and integration/end-to-end test automation for Data Pipeline services, primarily in the imports domain. Build and maintain automated test suites in CI/CD (GitLab) that gate deployments and catch regressions across components. Read Go/Python pipeline code well enough to find holes and design meaningful test cases - you don't need to ship features, you need to understand the system. Drive test strategy in grooming and design reviews - test types on the ticket, acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure modes. Pair with our current Data Pipeline QA to spread automation and code-adjacent testing practices across the team. Use telemetry and reproduction to turn production incidents into durable, automated regression tests. Our tech stack Languages: Python (primary), Go (enough to read pipeline code) Test automation: Robot Framework (API/integration and Browser-based E2E), CI-driven suites in GitLab, with ReportPortal / Allure reporting Platform you'll test against: Apache Kafka, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, BigQuery, MongoDB, Redis CI/CD & tooling: GitLab, Jira, Confluence AI coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, ... ... and much more Your qualifications Must have You write test automation in code - integration and API tests in CI, in Python / Go or a similar language. You can read backend/pipeline code (Go or Python) well enough to find gaps and reason about where a change can break something else. Useful QA sees the cross-component failure the feature author might missed. You are comfortable owning black-box, API and integration/end-to-end automation - the outside-in layer. (In-source unit and in-repo integration tests remain with the feature developers.) You want to work primarily in code and automation . If you are coming from a mostly manual testing background, that is fine - as long as you are excited to make automation your main craft, because that is where this role lives. You are comfortable in grooming and design from day one - a shift-left mindset, defining test types and cases on the ticket before code is written. You can learn and adapt - essential when navigating a large codebase and a data domain that mixes tracking, imports, and multiple storages. You know how to be effective in a remote-first environment. Fluent use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or similar) as part of your daily workflow. Strongly preferred Prior backend exposure (an internship or role where you wrote code, or worked under a senior who set up proper testing/automation workflows) - it makes the pipeline world far less of a black box. Experience with ETL / data-pipeline testing: connectors, ingest at scale, data cleanup and transformations, and validating data landing correctly in target storages. Experience testing systems built on Kafka, GCP, or BigQuery. Familiarity with test frameworks such as Robot Framework, Playwright or API testing tooling (Postman and beyond). Personal qualities Ownership - you take quality from detection through to a durable, automated fix that prevents the next regression. Systematic thinking - you find root causes, not symptoms, and you document what you learn so the team levels up. Collaboration - you make developers better at testing rather than becoming the place work gets "thrown over the wall". Curiosity - you enjoy peeling back a data pipeline until you understand what can go wrong and why. Your success story In 30 days Get to know the Data Pipeline team, the company, and the most important processes. Set up your local and cloud development environment and complete the Engagement engineering onboarding. Understand how our pipelines work end-to-end - tracking, imports, exports - and how we approach testing and automation, with a focus on the imports domain. In 90 days Deliver your first meaningful quality improvement: an automated integration or end-to-end suite for a real imports flow, wired into CI so it gates deployments. Be active in grooming and design reviews, defining test cases and surfacing edge cases and cross-component risks before implementation. Pair with our current QA to share automation practices and broaden the team's quality coverage. In 180 days Own the quality posture of the imports domain end-to-end - the team relies on your suites and your judgment on what "tested" means. Drive measurable improvements: more of the pipeline covered by repeatable automated tests, faster feedback in CI, and higher release confidence across the team. Extend your coverage and influence into the Data Pipeline core. Find out that our values are truly lived by us . We are dreamers and builders . title: Software Test Engineer
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Deepgram is looking for a Software Test Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and exploratory test suites across our products, models, APIs, and data platforms. You enjoy breaking systems, probing edge cases, testing real-world and adversarial inputs, and automating repeatable validation so regressions are caught quickly. You translate product requirements and model metrics into automated regression tests, evaluation pipelines, data-quality gates, load tests, and release criteria. You partner with QA, Research, Product, Data, and Engineering to plan testing, execute human and automated evaluations, support user acceptance testing, and communicate risks clearly. When you find an issue, you provide precise reproduction steps, inputs, parameters, expected and actual results, and supporting data. What gets you excited? Building scalable automation that gives Deepgram confidence that its products, models, and data workflows work reliably for customers. What You'll Do Define and execute well-designed test plans across Deepgram's products, APIs, SDKs, model-powered features, and data platforms, ensuring production software is robust, reliable, and performs well. Design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks for functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, API, browser, and service-level testing across batch and streaming workflows. Translate product requirements and customer acceptance criteria into clear test strategies, repeatable test cases, and enforceable release gates. Build and maintain representative, customer-focused, and adversarial test datasets, fixtures, and test environments that exercise real-world inputs, edge cases, failure modes, and system limits. Validate model-powered behavior—including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and other AI features—using appropriate metrics, expected outputs, human review, and regression coverage, while partnering with Research and model-evaluation specialists as needed. Build testing infrastructure, including test harnesses, reusable scripts, test-data tooling, result-aggregation pipelines, dashboards, and visualizations that make quality signals easy to understand and act on. Integrate automated tests, quality checks, canaries, and release validation into CI/CD so regressions are detected continuously rather than through manual testing alone. Partner with Engineering, Product, Research, Data, Infrastructure, and DevOps to understand system behavior, dependencies, variations, performance limits, and deployment risks, and to establish appropriate test coverage. Test data ingestion, processing, annotation, and quality-control workflows, validating data integrity, completeness, representativeness, deduplication, leakage, and downstream readiness. title: Senior Data Scientist
description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include: Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai , translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception. About You You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction. You can do 2 or more of the following: Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments Develop and deploy NLP solutions Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language. You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus. You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data. Strong, succinct communication, and the ability to work productively with a Brand and Marketing team focused on brand awareness. Alignment with GiveDirectly’s values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. Experience with tracking and attribution to ensure detailed reports are shared with senior management. Bonus skills: Experience with our tech stack (WordPress, Salesforce, PostHog, Google Analytics, Tableau, Zendesk, Ahrefs) or similar tools. What you’ll do Own paid media strategy and performance to execute growth and brand goals Develop and execute the paid digital fundraising strategy that acquires new donors, grows revenue, and strengthens long-term supporter value across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, programmatic, and emerging platforms (approx. 50% of time). Run top-of-funnel brand ads, from placement and contracting to creative direction and development, including podcasts, OOH, and connected TV (approx. 30% of time). Manage and optimize paid investment daily, monitoring spend, pacing, cost per acquisition, and conversion, and reallocating budget as performance dictates. Run a continuous test-and-learn program across audiences, creative messaging, channels, landing pages, and donation experiences, and turn results into decisions rather than reports. Make key and strategic recommendations to the Director of Individual Giving and VP of Marketing on where budget spend should be allocated based on performance data. Grow one-time and monthly giving through paid Run acquisition and conversion campaigns for both one-time and monthly giving, testing paid tactics to grow the recurring program—the fastest-growing part of our portfolio. Optimize the digital supporter journey so paid campaigns connect cleanly to landing pages, donation forms, email, and CRM, maximizing conversion and retention. Analyze acquisition, conversion, revenue, and retention trends by segment to inform where the next dollar goes. Build and maintain performance dashboards that connect campaign, website, and CRM data into a single view of what each channel returns. title: Legal Counsel, Emergency Cash & U.S. Programs
description: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do . If they resonate, this could be a great fit! About this role GiveDirectly is building a faster model for humanitarian response – using data, technology, and partnerships to identify people affected by crises and deliver cash within days. Making that possible requires legal pathways that can be established before a crisis and activated quickly when one occurs. We are seeking a Counsel to build and lead that legal model. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Emergency Cash, from preparing for future responses to leading the legal and regulatory work required during an active emergency. When a response is underway, EC work will take priority. You will also serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs, which work with governments, funders, researchers, and community organizations to deliver cash to low-income Americans. The portfolio includes programs such as Rx Kids, guaranteed-income initiatives, and housing-stability programs. You will help teams design and expand these programs, structure partnerships, and navigate the legal issues affecting delivery and recipients. This is a delivery-focused role for a practical lawyer who can build for scale, exercise clear judgment under pressure, and help ambitious programs move from idea to implementation. Reports to: Head of Legal Level : Senior Manager Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time. Travel Requirement: ~ 3–4 trips per year, plus travel as needed during active emergency responses. What you’ll do: Build and deliver the Emergency Cash legal model Serve as the primary legal partner to Emergency Cash across program strategy, design, launch, and delivery. Build a repeatable legal model for emergency responses, including approaches to country entry, regulatory review, government engagement, contracting, data use, and the engagement of local counsel. Develop response-readiness tools, templates, and decision frameworks that allow common issues to be addressed quickly while escalating matters requiring legal judgment. During active responses, lead the legal work needed to launch and operate on emergency timelines, providing clear recommendations when information is incomplete. Coordinate with country teams, program-facing Counsel, and local advisors to use existing knowledge and relationships while retaining legal ownership of the response. Apply GiveDirectly’s global standards for MNO data and remote enablement to individual responses, working with the Corporate & Strategic Affairs Counsel on novel or cross-cutting issues. Draft and negotiate the partnership, technology, vendor, data-sharing, and other agreements required to deliver emergency programs. Capture lessons from individual responses and use them to strengthen the EC legal model over time. Lead legal support for U.S. programs Serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs across program design, implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations. Advise on the legal design and delivery of U.S. cash programs, including eligible recipient populations, interactions with public benefits, tax treatment and reporting, payments involving minors or caregivers, family-law considerations, privacy and data use, and state-specific requirements. Structure and negotiate program-specific agreements with governments, research institutions, community organizations, payment providers, and other partners. Develop reusable guidance for recurring issues and coordinate state-specific or specialist counsel where needed. Contribute across Legal Work with the Corporate & Business Affairs Counsel on organization-wide standards and initiatives affecting Emergency Cash or U.S. programs. Partner with the Africa Programs & Country Operations Counsel when emergency responses occur in countries within that role’s portfolio. Work with Legal Operations support to delegate recurring contracting, research, coordination, and administrative work appropriately. Support other priority legal matters as needed as part of a small, global Legal team. What you’ll bring: Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve. Qualification as an attorney in at least one jurisdiction, with relevant post-qualification legal experience. Experience advising on complex program, commercial, or regulatory matters in fast-moving or high-pressure environments. Strong commercial contracting skills, including drafting and negotiating complex partnership, technology, vendor, or data-related agreements. Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar legal and regulatory frameworks and advise where precedent, time, or information is limited. Strong legal and business judgment, including the ability to identify meaningful risks, assess tradeoffs, and recommend a practical path forward. Ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for colleagues without legal backgrounds. Experience coordinating external counsel, consultants, or other specialist advisors. Working knowledge of data privacy and data protection law. Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and reprioritize quickly during active emergency responses. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; English fluency. Preferred: Experience in emergency response, humanitarian operations, or other crisis-context legal work. Experience supporting the launch of programs or operations in new countries. Experience with U.S. public-benefits, family-law, charitable-assistance, or government-program matters. Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, particularly in emerging markets. Experience supporting programs involving vulnerable populations or sensitive personal data. Experience in international development or another mission-driven organization.
