title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone. A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone. As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline. - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality. - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone. - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus. - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus. - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next. - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus. - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Build the iOS platform that helps engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning the first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, ergonomic testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. This role is broad—you’ll shape the iOS stack end to end, from shared frameworks and build systems to release quality, with opportunities to work across our shared Rust layer and AI infrastructure for mobile development. You’ll pair with mobile AI and core product engineers to understand friction, evaluate new iOS capabilities, and decide what should become part of the platform. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Make the iOS platform agent-ready: Give engineers and agents dependable ways to build, run, test, screenshot, and iterate through the app so mobile teams can move faster without lowering the quality bar. - By the end of your first year, define how iOS features are built: establish architecture and ship developer tools, then partner with product engineers to adopt them. - Raise the bar for iOS reliability and release quality: Improve the systems that catch regressions, prevent incidents, and help engineers understand issues quickly across builds, tests, observability, and CI/CD. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - Deep iOS engineering experience at scale: You’ve helped build and deploy mobile applications used by millions, and understand the reliability, performance, and operational practices required at that scale. - Platform or infrastructure experience: You’ve worked below the product-feature layer on mobile CI/CD, testing platforms, build systems, developer tooling, or shared frameworks—and can turn recurring friction into durable systems. - Strong architectural judgment: You’re familiar with multiple approaches to iOS architecture and can explain the trade-offs clearly, choosing patterns that make features easier to build, test, and maintain. - Cross-functional influence: You can partner closely with product engineers, understand their pain points, and earn adoption for new platform APIs, workflows, and standards without relying on authority. - AI-native engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.</p> <p>Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.</li> <li>Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.</li> <li>Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.</li> <li>Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Join Tier 2 <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/incident-management/on-call/tier-2/">on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.</li> <li>Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.</li> <li>Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations stage</a> builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.</p> <p>Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Staff Security Governance Engineer, you will be the individual contributor who owns how GitLab writes, maintains, communicates, and measures its security policies and standards. You will turn emerging regulations, including AI regulation, into clear requirements that engineering, product, and legal teams can act on, and you will use automation to keep governance lightweight and continuous rather than a point-in-time exercise. You will sit on the Security Governance team within Security Assurance and work closely with Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. You will report to the Director, Customer Trust & Security Governance.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>Policies and standards</em></li> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of GitLab's security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines: drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, annual review, and retirement.</li> <li>Define and run the exception policy.</li> <li>Maintain mappings between our policies and frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, so requirements are written once and reused.</li> </ul> <li><em>Measurement and assurance</em></li> <ul> <li>Define KPIs for policy adherence and report trends to Security leadership.</li> <li>Run targeted internal assessments of adherence and drive remediation to closure.</li> <li>Support audit activities by coordinating evidence, testing, and remediation management.</li> </ul> <li><em>Customer trust</em></li> <ul> <li>Support customer questionnaires and customer meetings, and help turn recurring customer requests into better policies and self-service content.</li> </ul> <li><em>Automation and AI</em></li> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted workflows for policy management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and assessment work, in partnership with GRC Engineering.</li> </ul> <li><em>Technical leadership</em></li> <ul> <li>Act as a technical and program leader across Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering, influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor other team members and help set the direction of the Security Governance roadmap.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years in security governance, GRC, or IT risk, with hands-on ownership of a policy and standards lifecycle and measurable outcomes, ideally at a global technology company.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, including how to put them into practice, not only how to read them.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud, SaaS, and DevSecOps practices, and the ability to write policy that engineers will follow.</li> <li>A risk-based mindset that balances compliance with real security risk.</li> <li>Demonstrated use of automation or AI to reduce manual GRC work.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for engineers, executives, auditors, and customers.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or similar are highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What success looks like</strong></h4> <ul> <li>First 30 days: Assessed the current policy library and exception process, built relationships with key stakeholders, and proposed a prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>First 90 days: Uplift the existing security policy library to align with NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, and PCI-DSS.</li> <li>First 120 days: A refreshed review cadence is in place, exception reporting is running, and can demonstrate a measurable improvement in policy adherence.</li> <li>First six months: Develop Policy as Code and collaborate with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering for implementation into existing workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. <br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.</li> <li>Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li>Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li>Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.</li> <li>Fluency in Arabic.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. The team is focused on helping customers modernize end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a rapidly evolving AI and DevSecOps landscape.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. remote work best practices.</li> <li>Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.</li> <li><span class="s1">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team! This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Sales: Understand current and future demand. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs. Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest. Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success. Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team. Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story. Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios. Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator). Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts. Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives. Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers. In the first three months, expect to: Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities. Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal. Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives. Become proficient in using our SaaS tools. Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com. In the first six months, expect to: Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives. Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs. Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptalâs partnerships, and continue to execute account plans. Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities. In the first year, expect to: Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list. Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelorâs degree is required. 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR. Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients. Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal. Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries. Conscientiousness. Weâre not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important. Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement. Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business. Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative. Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies. Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts. Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures. Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Prioritization. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.</li> <li>Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.</li> <li>Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strategic technical stewardship</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.</li> <li>Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.</li> <li>Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.</li> <li>Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.</li> <li>Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.</li> <li>Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.</li> <li>Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.</li> <li>Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.</li> <li>Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.</li> <li>Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.</li> <li>Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.</li> <li>The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.</li> <li>Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strongly preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.</li> <li>Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.</li> <li>Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, title: Client Advisor
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process. You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path. You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings. Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise. Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend. Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM. Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests. Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor. Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation. Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical. Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story. Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method. Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business. Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios. Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment. Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities. Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first three months, expect to: Be fully ramped and integrated into the team. Complete additional vertical-specific training. Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets. Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel. In the first six months, expect to: Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets. Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work. Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures. In the first year, expect to: Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies. Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients. Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio. Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team. Required Qualifications 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role). Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close. Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Full availability during your working hours to take client calls. Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role. Preferred Qualifications Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience. Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar. Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account. Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts. Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows. Core Competencies Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch. Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing. Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve. Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal. Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer. Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it. Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team. Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win. title: Intermediate-Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby), Plan: Spec-Driven Development
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. You'll own early-stage backend work across the flows, application programming interfaces, data models, and evaluation systems behind this experience, using Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.</p> <p>You'll join a small, distributed team working on one of GitLab's highest-visibility product bets, collaborating with design partners toward a public beta. In your first year, you'll lead major features from an unclear problem through release, help shape scope with product and users, mentor other engineers, and influence technical decisions across agent workflows and evaluation methods.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead backend features from early product discussions through technical design, implementation, rollout, and post-launch learning.</li> <li>Build the flows, application programming interfaces, and data models behind agent-generated work items, implementation plans, durable specifications, and mergeable code.</li> <li>Develop evaluation and benchmarking systems that measure workflow quality, token cost, and success rate.</li> <li>Use Ruby on Rails and Python to build reliable production systems, with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, representational state transfer, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.</li> <li>Collaborate directly with product, design, engineers, design partners, and users to shape scope and make practical trade-offs.</li> <li>Coordinate multi-person projects across the team and communicate decisions clearly in GitLab's asynchronous, all-remote environment.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical direction across the Plan group and related artificial intelligence initiatives.</li> <li>Work in short iterations, share progress through demos, and use results and user feedback to guide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails experience in a large production codebase and production experience with Python.</li> <li>Experience driving substantial projects with several engineers over multiple months, with clear user or business outcomes.</li> <li>A product mindset and experience owning features end to end, including shaping scope, making trade-offs, engaging with users, and learning from adoption after launch.</li> <li>A full stack background with a current focus on backend engineering, plus the ability to read modern frontend code and design effective APIs.</li> <li>Strong application programming interface design and structured query language fundamentals.</li> <li>Experience exploring artificial intelligence-assisted development.</li> <li>The ability to work independently, collaborate across functions and regions, and support others through technical leadership and mentoring. Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL performance at scale, or building and evaluating large language model or agent systems is helpful but not required.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We are a team of four engineers, with two backend and two frontend engineers across Canada and Europe. You'll work in an all-remote, async-first environment with weekly sync calls, retrospectives, demos, and short iterations. This is early-stage work with broad ownership, space for creativity, and a fast pace. title: Staff Data Scientist
location: Barcelona; Cardiff, London or Remote (UK); London
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍 London or Barcelona | UK remote | 💰 £124,400 - 165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> — <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/data">Data</a></h4> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.</p> <p>At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</p> <p><em>Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</em></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!</p> <h4><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs</li> <li>Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes</li> <li>Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster</li> <li>Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks</li> <li>Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work</li> <li>Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> <li>You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk</li> <li>You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility</li> <li>You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Technical assessment</li> <li>Final Interviews <ul> <li>Business Fit/Collaboration</li> <li>Case Study</li> <li>Technical Interview</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight.</p> <p>This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Enablement Roadmap:</strong> Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy..</li> <li><strong>AI Field Use Cases:</strong> Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>AI Field Champions: </strong>build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Ops Transformation Plan:</strong> Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.</li> <li><strong>AI Governance:</strong> Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Mid-Senior Experience:</strong> Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>AI Solutions Experience:</strong> Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. title: AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.</p> <p>Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.</p> <p>You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <h3>Strategy & Prioritization</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own your function's AI strategy,</strong> aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.</li> <li><strong>Map how work flows</strong> across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?</li> <li><strong>Manage intake</strong> of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize strategically</strong> against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.</li> </ul> <h3>Adoption & Change Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Reimagine, not just automate.</strong> Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption and change management</strong> together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate with Enterprise AI</strong> to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.</strong> Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On Building & Agent Operations</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build AI agents</strong> using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.</li> <li><strong>Author and iterate on skills files</strong> that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.</li> <li><strong>Configure MCP servers and tools,</strong> giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.</li> <li><strong>Own your function's fleet of agents.</strong> Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.</li> <li><strong>Expect to rebuild.</strong> AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Business & Strategic</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep knowledge of your function's operations.</strong> You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.</li> <li><strong>Strategic prioritization skills.</strong> You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>A product management mindset.</strong> You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and influence.</strong> You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional instincts.</strong> You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.</strong> You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On & Technical</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Comfortable building with AI tools.</strong> You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.</li> <li><strong>Ready to learn fast.</strong> Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.</li> <li><strong>Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities</strong> - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.</li> <li><strong>Ability to map data flows</strong> - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. team members to improve product quality, security, and performance.</li> <li>Participate in Tier 2 or Tier 3 weekday, weekend, and occasional night on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="line-height: 1;">Professional language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li value="3">Experience contributing to policy, permissions, or rules-based features in web applications and helping make that complexity reliable and maintainable.</li> <li value="4">Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with Git and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li value="5">Experience using artificial intelligence coding tools or agents, with the ability to review their output and recognize when additional guidance is needed.</li> <li value="6">Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates and collaborating in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">The ability to You’ll partner closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into concrete success plans, guide them along the customer journey, and drive hands-on enablement, adoption, utilization, and maturity. In your first year, success looks like driving customer outcomes through technical workshops and architecture guidance, developing trusted relationships with key stakeholders, increasing adoption of
