Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <h1>About our Machine Learning FinCrime Team:</h1> <p>Our Financial Crime Data team consists of over 25 people across 4 data specialisms: Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Machine Learning Scientists and Data Scientists. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be working in a fast moving environment, building and iterating on our financial crime defensive capabilities to ensure we keep Monzo and our customers safe.</p> <p>Our financial crime team has a large impact on Monzo’s bottom line as fraud and scams are usually some of the largest cost line items in a bank's P&L. We have a major influence on the overall customer experience and it’s our duty to keep our customers safe. The work we do results in directly measurable customer or company benefit, which is incredibly satisfying.</p> <p>Our Machine Learning Scientists work on a range of problems within the different financial crime areas ranging from fraud detection and prevention, transaction monitoring for different types of suspicious activity through to customer risk assessment and operational tooling.</p> <h1>What you’ll be working on:</h1> <p>A Lead Machine Learning Scientist at Monzo is a technical Individual Contributor (IC) leadership position. As a technical Machine Learning expert, working with billions of rows of data stored on a modern cloud native data platform, we’ll be expecting you to leverage your deep experience of developing and deploying advanced Machine Learning models to:</p> <ul> <li>Automatically and accurately detect suspicious user behaviours while minimising impact to genuine customers and operational costs</li> <li>Adapt quickly and appropriately to changing fraud and financial crime trends, ensuring our detection systems remain performant through time.</li> </ul> <p>The technical approaches you take to help solve these problems will be very much in your hands and we’ll strongly encourage and support experimentation and innovation. We’ll be expecting you to justify and demonstrate effectiveness along the way, making sure the approach meets our business and customer needs.</p> <h1>Your day-to-day:</h1> <p>As a technical individual contributor, you’ll be providing technical leadership and shipping highly impactful ML-based solutions. You’ll be embedded in a cross functional product squad, working closely with product managers, data scientists, backend engineers and designers in an agile environment. You’ll also be a technical leader within the Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.</p> <p>This will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Working with stakeholders across the organization to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to tackle Financial Crime and Fraud with Machine Learning.</li> <li>Leading the design and development of advanced real time Machine Learning models, for example exploring how neural network, graph-based, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in detection of financial crime.</li> <li>Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.</li> <li>Working closely with our MLOps team to steer the ongoing development of tools to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.</li> </ul> <h1>You should apply if:</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact</li> <li>You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>Reducing financial crime and protecting customers with data driven strategies sounds exciting to you</li> <li>You have extensive experience writing production Python code and a strong command of SQL. You are comfortable using them every day, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working with financial crime and in regulated institutions</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process:</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you: </h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.</li> <li>Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of designing <strong>high-quality web experiences</strong>, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.</li> <li>You’re comfortable using <strong>data to inform your design decisions</strong>, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.</li> <li>You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.</li> <li>You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.</li> <li>You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.</li> <li>You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.</li> <li>You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.<br>✈️ title: Operational Tax, Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. You’ll report into our Tax Governance Lead. </p> <p>This role covers all taxes that relate to customer liabilities or customer tax reporting. These are a core part of product design: we make sure we comply with our own obligations, and we make it as easy as possible for customers to comply with theirs. As we launch new products and enter new markets, this is a key area of our tax strategy, and this role gives you the exciting opportunity to own it and work closely with diverse teams across the business. </p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Owning operational tax:</strong> Be Monzo’s subject matter expert on operational tax, advising the business and making sure we meet our obligations as we grow and enter new markets.</li> <li><strong>Leading compliance & controls: </strong>Own our operational tax processes and controls across jurisdictions, including BBSI, ISA reporting, FATCA and CRS, Corporate Criminal Offence and CT61s, plus overseas equivalents. Build new processes and controls as our products and markets evolve.</li> <li><strong>Shaping new products:</strong> Partner with Product and local market teams from the outset to embed tax into product design, build the right reporting and controls, and pressure-test edge cases.</li> <li><strong>Staying ahead of change:</strong> Keep on top of tax laws, regulations and case law across the UK and EU, translating changes into clear actions and helping Monzo prepare for new requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partnering across Monzo: </strong>Work closely with Product, Financial Crime, Engineering, Legal, EU Next Markets and Finance to solve problems and support business initiatives from an operational tax perspective.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant and/or qualified tax advisor, or qualified by significant experience.</li> <li>You have significant in-house experience working in Operational Tax.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working relatively autonomously.</li> <li>You’re energetic and are hands-on with your work, tackling whatever needs doing to make things happen. </li> <li>You have an eye for detail and enjoy working methodically through processes.</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>💰 £94,700 - £111,400 + incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of working from the London office on occasional basis.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h3><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial video call with Tax member (30 mins)</li> <li>Case study video interview with Hiring Manager and Tax member (60 mins)</li> <li>Stakeholder interview (45 mins)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<br><br>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.<br><br>#LI-NZ1 #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Product Marketing Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p>This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.</li> <li><strong>MonzOS </strong>is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.</li> <li><strong>EU </strong>is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You and your team will…</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set strategy for multiple categories. </strong>You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.</li> <li><strong>Set the market intelligence agenda. </strong>You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.</li> <li><strong>Shape what gets built.</strong> You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning that moves the business. </strong>You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.</li> <li><strong>Own how we go to market.</strong> You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar for Product Marketing.</strong> You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think beyond a single product.</strong> You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.</li> <li><strong>You own the hardest calls in your domain.</strong> You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior people with you.</strong> You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You're a player/coach.</strong> You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£100,000 - £133,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do You'll lead a team of five Credit Analysts, shaping the evolution of our platform, pushing the boundaries to unlock the next generation of lending capabilities and drive efficiencies.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Learning, Data and Risk teams to build platform capabilities that accelerate experimentation, simplify strategy deployment and improve the speed and quality of credit decisioning.</p> </li> <li> infrastructure and frameworks that enable effective credit decisioning</li> <li><strong>You are highly motivated by fast-paced environments</strong>, enjoy ambiguity, designing frameworks from Credit teams to deliver shared platform capabilities.</li> <li><strong>You have a track record of leading and developing analytical talent</strong>, and you are excited by the prospect of leading a title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.<br><br>Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.</p> <p>You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-manager-framework-v2-0.pdf">Progression Framework</a>.</p> <p><strong>Is this role right for you?</strong></p> <p>While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</p> <p>We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery and Execution</strong>: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</li> <li><strong>Engineering and Operational Excellence</strong>: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership:</strong> Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</li> <li><strong>Technical Influence:</strong> Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Relationships:</strong> Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Organisational Wide Impact:</strong> Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</li> </ul> <p><em>We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)<br><br></li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).</li> </ol> <p>The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:</p> <p><em>- Team and Org Management (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.</p> <p><em>- System Design (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.</p> <p><em>- Behavioural (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.</p> <p><em>- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)</em><em><br></em>At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. </p> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a><br><br>#LI-Remote #LI-AL1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Senior Legal Counsel, Digital Assets and Payments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰circa £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tDAT6VxoqQM">Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Legal Counsel</strong> to join our team at Monzo to support our payments business including digital assets and emerging payment technologies. You will report to Monzo’s Director of Legal for Payments & Business Banking, be part of the Legal and Board Governance Collective, and act as a legal business partner for the teams working on these initiatives.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of payments, digital assets and emerging payments technologies. You’ll help teams navigate a rapidly evolving legal and regulatory landscape, helping Monzo innovate responsibly while protecting our customers. </p> <p>You’ll work at all levels in the organisation and with a wide-range of stakeholders from Product Managers and Designers, to Operations professionals and Software Engineers, and Risk, FinCrime and Compliance professionals. </p> <p>While payments, digital assets and emerging financial technologies will be your primary focus, more broadly, you will also have opportunities to work within a team of product lawyers to give first rate legal advice and support to Monzo’s Product Collectives, including in areas like personal and business banking. </p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ll work directly with senior lawyers, product managers and engineers to provide legal advice and commercial insights to develop and grow Monzo Bank in the UK - and internationally. </li> </ul> <p>In particular, you will: </p> <ul> <li>Partner with product managers to advise on legal matters, in particular relating to the impact of  digital assets and emerging financial technologies, and advise on the legal and regulatory requirements for Monzo. </li> <li>Help to develop efficient ways of working to enable Monzo to scale quickly, and ensuring Monzo operates safely and in accordance with the law and regulation.</li> <li>Provide training and knowledge sharing with other Monzonauts on the impact of laws and regulations for Monzo and our customers in your specialist area..</li> <li>Often act as the sole lawyer advising product managers or other colleagues, identifying legal issues proactively, evaluating relevant risks and finding effective solutions to unique and complex business activities. </li> <li>You’ll work closely and collaboratively with Monzo’s Director of Legal for Payments & Business Banking, Director of Product Legal, the General Counsel of Monzo Bank Limited and the other members of the UK Legal team to provide legal advice and commercial insights, in particular in relation to digital assets and other emerging financial technologies, to Product teams.</li> <li>You’ll be a trusted advisor and will work proactively and collaboratively with other relevant stakeholders and teams across the Monzo Group, including the Product, Risk & Compliance, Supplier Operations, Financial Crime, Fraud and Operations teams.</li> <li>You’ll advise on the evolving legal and regulatory framework for digital assets and emerging financial technologies, working with colleagues across the UK and EU to  to help us identify relevant local legal and regulatory requirements and apply them to our products.</li> <li>You’ll work with colleagues across the Legal and Board Governance Collective to improve the management of our teams’ activities, including through identifying suitable technology solutions to streamline workflows, optimise processes and efficiencies, and increase scalability.</li> <li>You’ll proactively manage relationships with external suppliers and law firms to enhance processes around cost management to ensure we are optimising our spend and extracting best value while delivering top-quality legal support. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a technically excellent lawyer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience, with recent experience of digital assets, emerging financial technologies and the evolving regulatory regime.</li> <li>You have demonstrated experience of advising on laws and regulations relevant to financial services, including the UK regulatory regime as it applies to digital assets and emerging payment technologies.   </li> <li>You are a team player and a keen problem solver, skilled at assessing risk and recommending solutions that balance commercial and risk considerations. title: Senior Security Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Central to this is making sure the bank is safe and secure for our customers. We’re always keen to hear from people who believe in our mission and want to join us on this journey.</p> <p>We’re looking for a proactive, curious, technically-minded and organised Senior Security Analyst to join Monzo's Security team. </p> <p>Our team is Monzo’s front door to Security, helping the whole business operate securely. This means you’ll get exposure to a wide range of business context and a broad mix of information security work. One day you might be assessing the security of a new supplier; the next you could be supporting an audit or assurance review, assessing the risks of a new product or technology change, updating a policy, or helping a team turn regulatory requirements into practical action.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with security specialists, engineers, product teams, third party risk, procurement, and colleagues from across Monzo to solve interesting problems and strengthen how we effectively manage security risk as we grow.</p> <p>We want security to protect Monzo without creating unnecessary friction or compromising user experience. You’ll have the opportunity to make a notable impact in an environment where security is both a priority and an opportunity for innovation! <br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Delivering third party security and supplier security assurance: assess new and existing suppliers, reviewing questionnaires, certifications, and other evidence to understand their security posture. Use your judgement to identify risks, translate technical findings into recommendations, and work with teams across Monzo to manage them throughout the supplier lifecycle. Help us build a more effective, scalable and industry-leading third party security capability as Monzo grows!</li> <li>Delivering security assurance activities: lead and contribute to control testing, PCI DSS assessments, regulatory reviews, and internal and external audits. Evaluate evidence, identify gaps and work with teams across Monzo to see findings and remediation through to completion.</li> <li>Strengthening our governance: improve security policies, procedures and controls so they’re practical, proportionate, and reflect how things work in reality. </li> <li>Supporting our Security Front Door: work alongside our other analysts to respond to security questions and requests from across Monzo, bringing in specialists when needed and finding ways to make the experience better for other Monzonauts.</li> <li>Taking ownership and running with it: turn loosely defined security problems into clear outcomes, work out the best way forward, and bring in the right people to make it happen.</li> <li>Helping teams build and change safely: work with engineers, product teams and other colleagues to understand what they’re trying to achieve. Review new products and technology or business changes, identify security risks and control gaps, and turn security and regulatory expectations into requirements that work in practice.</li> <li>Improving how we work: use data, automation and AI to make our processes simpler and more scalable, while exploring new ways technology can help us work smarter.</li> <li>Raising the bar for security: bring fresh perspectives to real-world security challenges, keep developing your own skills and knowledge, and help less experienced analysts grow.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand security risk: you’re comfortable identifying and assessing security risks, and can recommend proportionate ways to manage them. Experience in third party security or supplier security assurance would be a bonus!</li> <li>You can evaluate security evidence: you can review supplier questionnaires, security policies, penetration test reports and assurance evidence, and know when to dig deeper.</li> <li>You have strong security fundamentals and technical curiosity: you understand core security concepts and good practice, are comfortable getting into technical detail, and ask thoughtful questions to get to the heart of a problem.</li> <li>You think beyond the task in front of you: you look for patterns and root causes, use evidence and data to prioritise and look for ways to make things work better.</li> <li>You’re proactive: you can make progress independently, seek out the information you need, and are comfortable challenging assumptions to move things forward.</li> <li>You can manage competing priorities: you can juggle different pieces of work, keep people informed, and make sensible decisions about what needs attention or escalation.</li> <li>You’re a clear communicator: you can explain security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences in a way that works for them.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating: you like working with people across different disciplines, building strong relationships, and helping make security easier to do well.</li> <li>You’re passionate about security: you’re excited by the challenges and opportunities in cyber security, keep up with an evolving industry, and are motivated to continue developing your knowledge and skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙏 It would be great if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve worked in financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.</li> <li>You’ve supported PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or NIST-aligned assurance, regulatory reviews, or internal and external audits.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £57,000 - £70,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intro call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min call with the hiring manager</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Staff Analytics Engineer - Borrowing</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Borrowing Analytics Engineering Team</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission in Borrowing is to help people achieve their financial goals through better borrowing. Our customers borrow money to achieve something in their lives — whether that’s making a big life event affordable, buying something they need now without affecting their monthly budget, or getting by until payday. We’re shaping this mission by building products our customers love, while safely scaling some of Monzo’s biggest revenue lines.</p> <p>Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most complex and fastest-growing domains. We operate 12+ products across multiple geographies, underpinned by 1,700+ data models and an analytics engineering team that’s scaling to match. We’re in the middle of a major data architecture transformation, expanding into new markets, and building the next generation of data infrastructure to support it all.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to help shape how Borrowing builds and uses data at scale. Reporting to the Borrowing Data Director, you’ll work across product, credit, engineering, Data Platform, and analytics engineering teams to turn complex technical problems into clearer systems, stronger data products, and better business decisions.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architecting Borrowing’s data layer at scale.</strong> Partnering across Analytics Engineering, Product, Engineering, Credit, and Data Platform to shape how 1,700+ models across 12+ products are structured, connected, and evolved. You’ll set shared patterns that help teams build trusted, consistent, and scalable data products across Borrowing.</li> <li><strong>Designing and governing data products</strong>. Moving us beyond ad-hoc tables toward well-defined, contractual data assets with clear ownership, SLAs, documentation, and interfaces. You’ll work with teams across Borrowing and Data Platform to define what makes a Borrowing dataset “production-grade” and consumable by analytics, ML, decisioning, and regulatory teams.</li> <li><strong>Building feature stores and reusable analytical assets</strong>. Identifying cross-product signals (credit behaviour, repayment patterns, affordability, risk indicators) that should be modelled once, tested rigorously, and consumed by many. You’ll design the layer that turns raw product data into curated, versioned features that power models, dashboards, and decisions.</li> <li><strong>Scaling our analytics engineering infrastructure</strong>. Shaping the tooling, patterns, and developer experience that make an 80+ person credit and data organisation more productive. This means influencing our data architecture and ways of working across data and credit disciplines, while partnering with the central Data Platform team to ensure Borrowing’s needs are reflected in ingestion, streaming, and schema contract design.</li> <li><strong>Driving cross-product data consistency</strong>. As we expand across geographies and product lines, ensuring our data models are coherent and comparable. You’ll work with AE leads and domain experts to define shared conventions and abstractions that allow us to reason about Borrowing as a whole, not just product-by-product.</li> <li><strong>Being a senior technical partner for Borrowing’s data estate.</strong> Partnering with backend engineers on source data payload design, with product managers on measurement strategy, with credit teams on decisioning data, and with senior leadership on what’s possible and what’s next.</li> <li><strong>Leading through influence and leverage. </strong>You won’t manage people directly, but you’ll shape how an entire domain builds data. You’ll multiply the impact of AEs across Borrowing by setting the right patterns, unblocking architectural decisions, and raising the bar on what good looks like.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think in systems, not just queries.</strong> You’ve designed data architectures that span multiple products or domains, and you know how to keep them coherent as they scale. You can take ambiguous problems and turn them into a clear technical direction, delivery sequence, and set of trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>You’ve built data products, not just data models.</strong> You understand the difference between a table that exists and a data asset that’s governed, documented, versioned, discoverable, and trusted. You’ve defined SLAs, contracts, interfaces, or ownership models for data consumers, and you’re excited to do this at scale.</li> <li><strong>You have deep fluency with analytics engineering systems and infrastructure.</strong> dbt at scale, BigQuery or equivalent, CI/CD for data, testing frameworks, and orchestration. You don’t just use these tools, you shape how teams use them. You’ve hit the scaling limits and know what to do about them.</li> <li><strong>You can design reusable feature layers.</strong> You’ve designed, contributed to, or have a clear vision for reusable feature layers that serve multiple consumers, including ML pipelines, dashboards, decisioning engines, and regulatory reporting. You understand the trade-offs between freshness, cost, granularity, correctness, and ease of use.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable at the platform boundary.</strong> You can have a productive conversation with a Data Platform engineer about ingestion patterns, streaming vs. batch trade-offs, schema evolution, and infrastructure costs. You don’t need to build the platform, but you need to shape what it delivers.</li> <li><strong>You connect technical choices to business outcomes.</strong> You care about whether data models, feature layers, and platform patterns actually improve decisions. You understand how product, credit, engineering, and operational teams use data, and you use that context to align people around better technical choices.</li> <li><strong>You lead through others.</strong> You create leverage not by writing more SQL, but by setting patterns, reviewing designs, unblocking teams, and raising the standard. You’re energised by making 30+ people more effective, not by being the single expert.</li> <li><strong>You communicate across altitudes.</strong> You can whiteboard a data architecture with a back-end engineer in the morning and present a strategic data roadmap to a director in the afternoon. You adapt your message to your audience without losing precision.</li> <li><strong>You care about credit products.</strong> You’re excited, or curious, about the complexity of lending, including risk, affordability, regulatory constraints, and multi-product dynamics. You see it as a fascinating data domain, not just a business vertical.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Our typical process is structured as:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call</li> <li>Initial call  </li> <li>3 x 1 hours sessions (final interview)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰  £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-AS #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
